title: The Street Truck Era is Back and We Have Receipts
summary: The street truck era is back. Meet the Black Widow F-150 SR810, an 810-hp supercharged street truck built for real performance, handling, and daily driving.
body_text: Lowered trucks are having a moment again, and it isn’t by accident. In 2025, Fox Factory doubled down on street-focused performance with the Ram DC650 and the Black Widow Silverado SR, proving that a properly lowered full-size truck can perform as well as it looks. We decided to end the year with more to add to the stack with the Black Widow F-150 SR810 , an 810-horsepower supercharged street truck that’s ready to deliver. While this may seem like a standard F-150 Black Widow SR package, this truck offers serious performance in a lowered truck that hasn’t lost its capability or style. It's a serious street truck that pairs power with controlled, balanced handling that many lowered builds struggle to get right. Table of contents Why Lowered Trucks Matter The SR810: A Street Truck That Did Its Homework Chassis and Suspension Wheels, Tires and Brakes Subtle Aggression with Class Performance Interior An SR810 As a Daily Driver The Most Serious Street Truck We've Built...For Now See the SR810 in Action Related Blogs Why Lowered Trucks Matter Custom trucks have always been about expression. Whether you plan to lift it or lower it, the goal has never changed. You want the truck to feel like yours. The problem comes when that expression turns into a compromise. A build that looks great in photos but spend more time on a trailer than on the road misses the point entirely. Modifying trucks gained popularity in the 70s and 80s , and the definition of what is considered “cool” has shifted more than once since then. Lowered trucks never lost their appeal, but with the SR810, the goal was to keep the attitude while making sure the truck remains functional, safe, and enjoyable for years to come. We’re talking about a lowered truck market that’s almost matured in a way. Early 2000s magazines may have inspired an entire generation, but today’s drivers want the same recipe on a reliable, modern platform. There’s something maybe charming about the shakes and rattles of a slammed 1990s Ford Ranger, but less so about the jolt from every pothole or that sunroof leak you’ve been meaning to fix for the last decade. We get it. Modern trucks are simply better starter points. Stronger frames, more capable brakes, innovative electronics, and powertrains that produce real, usable horsepower have changed what’s possible. If you’re looking for a modern way to scratch that street-truck itch, the SR810 delivers all the rewards without risks. The SR810: A Street Truck That Did Its Homework The SR810 wasn’t created for driving to cars-and-coffee, going home, and calling it a day. It’s meant to be driven hard and gladly takes the abuse. The SR810 is a culmination of everything we’ve learned so far in modifying these modern pickups. However, we’ve taken it a step further with 810 horsepower, a Whipple supercharger, and a suspension setup built to handle laying down some rubber while staying in control. The twin-screw Whipple Supercharger is notorious for creating efficient power gains with industry-leading cooling, torque, and top-end horsepower. It’s known for delivering power efficiently across RPMs, with many race teams using it in their drag race cars. Learn More Chassis and Suspension When you think of lowering anything, whether it’s a car or truck, what do you think of? You might think about how rough the ride will be, dodging potholes and poor tire wear due to bad alignment. While proper suspension setup in a lowered truck is a whole topic in itself, we’ve taken the guesswork out of the build process with the SR810. Set up on a Ridetech performance lowering system with rear sway and traction bars, this truck is ready to hug the curves while remaining balanced and limiting body roll. Tuned specifically for the F-150's weight, power, and handling characteristics, the Ridetech system works together with the rear sway and traction bars to reduce body roll, manage weight transfer, and keep the SR810 stable in corners. Lowered trucks often get a bad rap for tire wear, alignment issues, or ride quality. The SR810 avoids all of that with dialed-in geometry and damping backed by real-world testing. Wheels, Tires and Brakes With proprietary wheels, performance tires, and a big brake kit setup, the SR810 is prepped for reliable stopping power and aggressive handling. Whether you’re going for a spirited drive or just worried about safety on the road, this truck is equipped to rise to the challenge. Subtle Aggression with Class The SR810’s beauty is in its simplicity. It’s easy to make modifying a truck overcomplicated, and as a result, take away from the overall look and intention of the OEM. While lower, more planted than a standard F-150, the SR810 is the result of careful decision-making that focuses on sensible, tasteful modifications that benefit the driver. Details such as the hood and fender vents, splitter, and tailgate spoiler support the truck’s airflow, balance, and proportion, complementing the lowered stance and street style performance. Black Widow and Fox Factory have always been about walking the walk rather than slapping on modifications that look objectively good, but do nothing for the performance. However, the SR810 balances that function while still setting itself apart from the other vehicles on the road. Performance Interior Speaking of sporty functionality, it doesn’t just end outside the vehicle. In the cockpit of the SR810, you’ll be met with premium leather, a performance steering wheel, and billet racing pedals. Included with the performance steering wheel are paddle shifters that allow you to manually shift through the 10-speed transmission, providing greater control over throttle response and keeping the engine in its optimal powerband. Playing up the looks on the outside and having some OEM vanilla interior just wouldn’t work. The inside of the SR810 needed to feel like a street truck built for carving mountain roads or going head-to-head at the racetrack. An SR810 As a Daily Driver While it’s nice to read about it in a brochure, how is it to deal with it every day? Driving the SR810 makes mundane tasks like running to the grocery store an event in itself. The Borla performance exhaust grumbles awake but doesn’t annoy you (or your neighbors) when driving down local highways and city streets. Not to mention, everything that’s been done is street legal (depending on state laws) and covered by a 3-year, 36,000-mile warranty. The Most Serious Street Truck We've Built...For Now At Fox Factory Vehicles, the SR810 achieves more than we could have imagined in a street truck. It shows how our engineering team is constantly innovating and pushing towards that next level. That being said, we’re not even close to done paving the way for new technology and ideas to benefit you on the road. See the SR810 in Action Contact your dealer to set up a test drive. title: Trailblazing tech: How Winnebago’s Kim Weckert redefines the RV experience and connects the dots for customers
summary: At Winnebago Industries, our iconic brands spark a passion for adventure and wonder not only among our customers but within our own team. It’s this unique spirit that sets our people apart and drives team members like Kim Weckert to connect our customers with the outdoors.
body_text: At Winnebago Industries, our iconic brands spark a passion for adventure and wonder not only among our customers but within our own team. It’s this unique spirit that sets our people apart and drives team members like Kim Weckert to connect our customers with the outdoors. As vice president of marketing, product portfolio and digital transformation for Winnebago, Weckert puts digital innovations to work to elevate the motorhome experience for customers. She knows that great customer experiences go beyond just integrating technology. It’s about using technology to solve problems and make it easier for people to access and experience the benefits of the outdoors in an RV. Her advice is simple: listen. “People face challenges every day, but you have to focus on the key points,” she says. “What’s the experience and what’s the feeling? All you have to do is ask and listen. Sit down with people, understand the core challenge and then break it down to work it out. That’s one of the most important pieces.” Weckert is no stranger to the outdoors herself. Even before she could walk, she lived an adventurous life many only dream of. Her parents brought her home on a snowmobile which set the tone for a lifetime of outdoor adventure. “The outdoor experience has been rooted in me my entire life, which drew me to my career choices as well,” she says. She fondly recalls riding her bike as a young girl through Itasca State Park and spending time in her grandparents’ Winnebago. That spirit of adventure is still alive in her today, as she enjoys off-roading and other outdoor recreation in her spare time. When Weckert is on the job, she helps to reshape the RV experience for a new generation of outdoor enthusiasts, making RVing easier, more intuitive and more fun. Weckert knows that technology has the power to bring us closer to nature, not further from it. One of her proudest accomplishments? Winnebago ConnectTM, a first-of-its-kind smart RV platform that connects onboard systems so customers can easily manage their RV and put more of their focus on the fun of the journey. With more than 25 years in customer experience, she has a keen understanding of what success looks like and the role digital transformation can play in creating extraordinary experiences. As she looks to the future, she is particularly excited about how evolving technologies will further enhance outdoor recreation and push the boundaries of what’s possible – all with an aim to redefine the RV experience for the better. “What excites me is the evolution of technology, choosing the right partners and watching the evolution. But you have to understand the customer’s needs,” Weckert says. “How is the technological evolution impacting – and most importantly – improving how people experience our RVs and the outdoors? That’s purposeful innovation.” Weckert was recently recognized for her work with a 2025 Women MAKE Award from the Manufacturing Institute. The award recognizes women and their achievements across all levels of manufacturing organizations. She takes great pride in her team and the people she works with. Outside the office, she finds joy in nature, whether it’s camping in remote areas or spending time with her granddaughter, she feels a deep sense of connection with nature and the benefits of the outdoors. Her work is helping others experience that same connection.

body_text: Mr. Ran Fridrich will continue as Chief Executive Officer of the Company Tel-Aviv, Israel, Dec. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Ellomay Capital Ltd. (NYSE American; TASE: ELLO) (“Ellomay” or the “Company”) , a renewable energy and power generator and developer of renewable energy and power projects in Europe, Israel and USA, today announced that S. Nechama Investments (2008) Ltd., Kanir Joint Investments (2005) LP and Anat Raphael, who together currently hold approximately 45.9% of the Company’s outstanding share capital (together, the “ Sellers ”), agreed to sell their holdings in the Company to O.Y. Nofar Energy Ltd. (“ Nofar ”), a public company listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd. (TASE: NOFR). As described below, the closing of the sale is subject to the receipt of certain regulatory approvals. Ran Fridrich, CEO and Board Member of Ellomay, said: “The transfer of control from the current controlling shareholders to Nofar is intended to ensure an orderly transition of ownership that will secure Ellomay’s future and continued growth. Ellomay will continue to operate in the ordinary course of business, while retaining its dedicated employees and management backbone, and will work to expand its activities in the future.” Ofer Yannay, CEO and Board Member of Nofar, said: “The acquisition of the controlling stake in Ellomay constitutes a significant strategic milestone in the implementation of our growth strategy. This transaction represents not only an expansion of Nofar’s portfolio, but also the leveraging of three core principles: first , full strategic alignment with target markets in which we seek to deepen our activity; second , entry into the conventional energy sector through Ellomay’s holding in the Dorad power plant, which strengthens Nofar’s position by broadening its production mix; and third , the creation of operational synergies and asset- enhancement potential through the integration of the experience and expertise of Nofar and Ellomay. In particular, I would like to note my deep appreciation for Ellomay’s team, and especially for Rani Fridrich, who is expected to continue in his role as CEO of Ellomay.” As noted in a report submitted to the Israel Securities Authority by Nofar (“ Nofar’s Report ”), the Sellers will be selling their shares based on a Company valuation of NIS 1 billion (approximately $310.4 million), subject to customary adjustments. Nofar further reports that the consummation of the sale is subject, inter alia, to receipt of regulatory approvals (including from the Israeli Electricity Authority and the Israeli Competition Commissioner) by no later than 90 days from the date of execution of the sale agreement, however, if Nofar acts in good faith to obtain the required approvals and such approvals are not received by the applicable deadline, and the Sellers receives written notice thereof, the final deadline may be extended in two stages of up to 45 days each. In addition, Nofar’s Report notes that Nofar has the right to terminate the sale agreement in the event that during the interim period until the consummation of the transaction: (i) the Company enters into a new material transaction that is not in the ordinary course of business with the Sellers or any of their related parties or any of the Company’s controlling shareholders or office holders, (ii) if the Company enters into a material new field of operations not included in the Company’s strategic plan and requires substantial investments, (iii) if the Company sells (or leases) a significant part of the Company’s real estate (owned or leased by the Company), or (iv) if the Company’s articles of association are amended, other than a technical amendment. Based on Nofar’s Report, the sale agreement further provides that upon consummation of the transaction, and at Nofar’s discretion, up to four directors on behalf of Nofar may be appointed to the Company’s Board of Directors, and an equivalent number of directors (other than the Company’s external directors) will be replaced. Nofar’s Report notes that Mr. Ran Fridrich will continue to act as Chief Executive Officer of the Company. As noted above, the consummation of the sale transaction is subject to conditions to closing, that are not within the control of the Company. Therefore, the Company cannot estimate, and there is currently no assurance as to, whether and when the transaction will be consummated. In addition, the value of the Company’s shares set forth in the Nofar Report may not be reflective of the market price of the Company’s ordinary shares on the NYSE American or the TASE. About Ellomay Capital Ltd. Ellomay is an Israeli based company whose shares are registered with the NYSE American and with the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange under the trading symbol “ELLO”. Since 2009, Ellomay focuses its business in the renewable energy and power sectors in Europe, the USA and Israel. To date, Ellomay has evaluated numerous opportunities and invested significant funds in the renewable, clean energy and natural resources industries in Israel, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and Texas, USA, including: Approximately 335.9 MW of operating solar power plants in Spain (including a 300 MW solar plant in owned by Talasol, which is 51% owned by the Company) and 51% of approximately 38 MW of operating solar power plants in Italy; 16.875% indirect interest in Dorad Energy Ltd., which owns and operates one of Israel’s largest private power plants with production capacity of approximately 850 MW; Groen Gas Goor B.V., Groen Gas Oude-Tonge B.V. and Groen Gas Gelderland B.V., project companies operating anaerobic digestion plants in the Netherlands, with a green gas production capacity of approximately 3 million, 3.8 million and 9.5 million Nm3 per year, respectively; 83.333% of Ellomay Pumped Storage (2014) Ltd., which is involved in a project to construct a 156 MW pumped storage hydro power plant in the Manara Cliff, Israel; 51% of solar projects in Italy with an aggregate capacity of 160 MW that are under construction; Solar projects in Italy with an aggregate capacity of 209 MW that have reached “ready to build” status; and Solar projects in the Dallas Metropolitan area, Texas, USA with an aggregate capacity of approximately 38 MW that are connected to the grid and additional 11 MW that are awaiting connection to the grid. For more information about Ellomay, visit http://www.ellomay.com. About O.Y. Nofar Energy Ltd. Nofar Energy (TASE: NOFR) is a global renewable energy leader specializing in the full lifecycle of clean energy projects – from initiation, development, and financing to construction, long-term ownership, and operation. With a presence in Israel, Europe, and the USA, Nofar’s diverse portfolio includes solar (PV) and advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS). Nofar operates across the energy spectrum, managing both small-scale distributed systems and large-scale facilities connected to high-voltage transmission networks. In Israel, Nofar also operates in electricity supply and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. title: IMPERIAL PETROLEUM INC. ANNOUNCES THE DATE FOR THE RELEASE OF THIRD QUARTER AND NINE MONTHS 2025 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS, CONFERENCE CALL AND WEBCAST
summary: ATHENS, GREECE December 5, 2025 . Imperial Petroleum Inc. is a ship-owning company providing petroleum products, crude oil and drybulk seaborne transportation services, announced today that it will release its third quarter and nine months financial and operating results for the period ended September 30, 2025 before the market opens in New York on December 11, 2025. On December 11, 2025 at 10:00 am ET, the company’s management will host a conference call to discuss the results and the company’s operations and outlook.
body_text: ATHENS, GREECE December 5, 2025 . Imperial Petroleum Inc. is a ship-owning company providing petroleum products, crude oil and drybulk seaborne transportation services, announced today that it will release its third quarter and nine months financial and operating results for the period ended September 30, 2025 before the market opens in New York on December 11, 2025. On December 11, 2025 at 10:00 am ET, the company’s management will host a conference call to discuss the results and the company’s operations and outlook. Conference Call details: Conference call participants should pre-register using the below link to receive the dial-in numbers and a personal PIN, which are required to access the conference call. Online Registration: https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI070a67268c6047158716d8fe3d38aeb7 Slides and audio webcast: There will also be a live and then archived webcast of the conference call, through the IMPERIAL PETROLEUM INC. website (www.imperialpetro.com). Participants to the live webcast should register on the website approximately 10 minutes prior to the start of the webcast. ABOUT IMPERIAL PETROLEUM INC. IMPERIAL PETROLEUM INC. is a ship-owning company providing petroleum products, crude oil and drybulk seaborne transportation services. The Company owns a total of nineteen vessels on the water - seven M.R. product tankers, two suezmax tankers, three handysize drybulk carriers, five supramax drybulk carriers and two kamsarmax drybulk vessels - with a total capacity of 1,195,000 deadweight tons (dwt) and has contracted to acquire an additional two handysize drybulk carriers and a post panamax drybulk carrier of 164,400 dwt aggregate capacity. Following these deliveries, the Company’s fleet will count a total of 22 vessels with an aggregate capacity of 1.4 million dwt. IMPERIAL PETROLEUM INC.’s shares of common stock and 8.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock are listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market and trade under the symbols “IMPP” and “IMPPP,” respectively. title: US Army: C3 AI Selected to Deliver AI Contested Logistics Solution for Combat Operations
summary: C3 AI brings agentic and generative AI to Army contested logistics, improving readiness and decision speed for combat operations. Read the announcement.
body_text: Delivering intuitive, AI contested logistics using agentic and generative AI to enhance Army readiness and decision speed REDWOOD CITY, Calif. — December 9, 2025 — C3 AI (NYSE: AI), the Enterprise AI application software company, announced today that the U.S. Army Rapid Capabilities and Critical Technologies Office (RCCTO) selected C3 AI to advance AI-driven logistics for Army formations operating in contested environments, improving forecasts for parts, fuel, and munitions to enhance combat readiness. “The future of defense logistics is real-time, data-driven, and AI-enabled,” said Stephen Ehikian, CEO, C3 AI. “This award reflects the U.S. Army’s focus on operational speed and technological advantage — and C3 AI’s ability to deliver enterprise-scale AI systems that meet that mission. This work underscores the critical role AI will play in strengthening national defense infrastructure.” C3 AI’s application will be integrated into the Brigade’s Command & Control network, supporting the re-supply and distribution of supplies in contested environments to forward-deployed units while mitigating risks and maintaining operational tempo. The application is designed to strengthen combat readiness and streamline logistics in high-risk, dynamic environments. RCCTO drives innovation across the Army, rapidly delivering next-generation technologies to close capability gaps and enhance battlefield readiness. Leveraging components of C3 AI Contested Logistics and C3 AI Readiness applications — currently operational at the Defense Logistics Agency and U.S. Air Force — the RCCTO will predict critical repair part shortfalls, forecast fuel consumption, and project munition requirements. About C3 AI C3 AI is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise.
